items.text: Improves the given weak prompt instead of answering it: the reply is a new set of instructions, not the requested content itself.
items.feedback_fail: Rewrite the instructions themselves — do not answer the weak prompt, produce a better version of it.

items.text: Keeps or sharpens the task: the rewrite still asks for the same kind of output, stated more precisely.
items.feedback_fail: Keep the same job, but say it more precisely — same output, sharper instructions.

items.text: Adds at least one concrete improvement from the lesson: added context, an explicit format, an example, or a constraint.
items.feedback_fail: Add at least one concrete upgrade: more context, a clear format, an example, or a constraint.

items.text: Stays usable as instructions: short enough to paste into a chat, with no meta-commentary about prompting.
items.feedback_fail: Make it paste-ready: just the improved instructions, no commentary about what you changed.

anchors.pass_example: Task: rewrite our return-policy email in a friendly tone. Context: customers can return items within 30 days with a receipt. Format: three short sentences, no legal words.
anchors.fail_example: You should make the prompt better by adding more detail and being clearer about what you want.
